publishedScreenshot.source: Actual local Chromium rendering; no generated or composited product image.

guidance.application: Representative ordinary text uses 4.5:1 and large text uses 3:1. Computed font size and weight determine the threshold.
Standalone main controls are measured against 24 by 24 CSS pixels. Inline-link exceptions are not treated as failures.

limitations: Local browser acceptance establishes the checked source presentation and interaction behavior; deployment identity requires separate live HTTP verification.
Contrast samples use actual computed colors and alpha-composited ancestor backgrounds. They are representative measurements, not a complete accessibility certification.
Long labels are tested at the supported 60 Unicode code point boundary. Existing financial result contracts are checked for preservation; this pass does not repeat the independent mathematical audit.
This is a compact record of observed local checks, not an external financial or accessibility audit.
The 35 earlier workflow checks are listed separately from the 266 final presentation checks; they were not rerun in the final focused pass.
Publication identity, ordinary HTTPS and deployed browser observations are separate checks made after this source commit.
Historical release receipts and downloadable v4.0.0 artifacts retain their original bytes and scope.
